page.layout: One column of running text and worked sums, with a marginal note at the lower right. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: Quæritur quot Thaleros retinuerit? primùm per Additionem numero, quot acce-perit, hoc modo:
Iam majorem numerum primùm scribo: deinde minorem directè subnoto:
Et dico 9 ab 11 remanent 2, sed 1 suprà no-to, & 1 sequenti notę, à qua inferior subtra-hi nequit, præpono, & pergo dicens: 7 à 10 remanent 3: 7 à 9 remanent 2: 4 ab 8, rema-nent 4.

page.notes: The marginal word at the lower right is cut off at the scan edge; read as "Alind" with the last letter doubtful, probably "Aliud". Some digits in the sums carry small printed marks (a dot or stroke after 6 in 7968, after 4 in 8048, and in 11·098); these are printer's marks and are not transcribed as text. The top of the page has the running head "DE ARITHMETICA" with a trailing mark. No catchword or signature is visible.
